## ObsidiAI 0.1.9

### PDF attachments

- Attach PDFs through the computer file picker, drag and drop, or clipboard file paste.
- Extract embedded text locally in page order. Preview the extracted text before sending; only that text, under the original filename, enters model context and saved history.
- PDF text works with text-only models. No OCR or page/image rendering is included; scanned PDFs without embedded text need OCR first. Complex layouts and tables may not preserve reading order.
- Enforce limits of **20 MiB**, **500 pages**, and **200,000 extracted characters** per PDF. Reject invalid, unsupported, empty-text, and oversized documents rather than silently truncating them. Password-protected PDFs may be rejected.
- Update attachment picker hints and the user guide. Bundle exact-pinned `unpdf@1.8.1`; no separate PDF worker installation is needed.

### Install or update

1. Download **[obsidiai-0.1.9.zip](https://github.com/KNN-07/ObsidiAI/releases/download/0.1.9/obsidiai-0.1.9.zip)**, not GitHub's automatic source archive.
2. Replace `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` in `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/obsidiai/`. Preserve `data.json` and `history.json` if present.
3. Reload Obsidian or disable/re-enable ObsidiAI after the current run settles.

Requirements remain **Obsidian desktop 1.11.4+** and **embedded Node 22.19.0+**. The three individual plugin files are also attached.

### Verification

- Production build, all **168 tests**, release metadata/assets validation, and generated-bundle syntax checks passed.
- Attachment tests cover compressed multipage extraction, basename retention, invalid signatures, damaged/mislabeled PDFs, empty text, and byte/page/extracted-text limits.
- An isolated CommonJS bundle smoke check extracted text from a real PDF through the attachment input path using the production bundler configuration.
- Native Obsidian file-picker, drag/drop, clipboard, and preview interactions for PDFs have not been verified.
